data.name: Dehydrating Strike
data.description: As a free action as part of a melee attack, a wasteland meditant can draw the moisture out of a living creature damaged by his unarmed strike. Unless the creature succeeds at a Will save (DC %1), the creature is|10+MonkLVL/2+WIS

raw_tokens.value: As a free action as part of a melee attack, a wasteland meditant can draw the moisture out of a living creature damaged by his unarmed strike. Unless the creature succeeds at a Will save (DC %1), the creature is|10+MonkLVL/2+WIS
The creature struck is also staggered for 1 round if it fails its save.

When used against a plant creature or a creature with the water subtype, dehydrating strike inflicts the above conditions (as applicable) on a failed save and also deals 1d6 points of damage, plus %1d6 additional points of damage. This damage is in addition to the wasteland meditant's normal unarmed strike damage. A wasteland meditant can use this ability %2 times per day but only once per round. Creatures immune to critical hits or precision damage are immune to this ability.|MonkLVL/4|3+WIS
